acceptance: All frozen probes, including failed removal attempts, are retained. Shared replay regenerated each source from its seed plus hashed edit recipe, recompiled real MWCC objects, and repeated object/relocation checks. Source SHA key sets, exact-match verdicts and aligned-word error counts were compared programmatically with the original reports; all agree.
limits: Reproduction of a failed probe is evidence, not acceptance. No new fully natural functions are claimed. Original selected-best archives remain available; these all-sources archives additionally retain every frozen probe.
